waitingApproval: Waiting for the presenter to connect this screen.
invitationInvalid: This connection link can no longer be used. Open a fresh link from the presenter view.
invitationExpired: This connection link has expired. Open a fresh link from the presenter view.
invitationRetryable: The connection request could not be sent. Check the network and try again.
consoleOnlyNotice: Open this presentation screen from the presenter view. Opening this page alone won't start it.
joinFailed: The presentation screen could not start. Close it and open it again from the presenter view.
approvalFailed: The presentation screen could not be connected. Close it and open it again.
awaitingPresentation: Waiting for the presentation to start.
audienceUnavailable: The connection to the presenter view was lost.
fullscreenBlocked: The browser blocked full screen. Use the browser menu instead.
fullscreenUnavailable: Full screen isn't available in this browser.
slideUnavailable: The slide could not be shown. Please check the presenter view.
targetPlaced: Moved this window to the selected screen.
targetRecovered: The target screen was disconnected. This window moved to an available screen.
placementExtend: Manual placement: move this window to the target display, then go full screen.
placementDuplicate: Manual placement: keep only the presentation screen on this PC, open the presenter view on another device, then go full screen.
placementSingle: Manual placement: keep only this window on the presentation screen, then go full screen.
